blurb: Guests receive therapeutic massage treatments tailored to various conditions including pain, injury, and stress relief. Initial appointments are 75 minutes including assessment and treatment. Techniques include deep tissue, trigger point therapy, joint mobilizations, myofascial work, craniosacral therapy, and TMJ treatment.
extraNote: 50% fee for cancellations with less than 24 hours notice; 100% fee for no-shows or late arrivals over 15 minutes without notice. · No charge for cancellations due to sudden contagious illness. · Multiple short-notice cancellations may result in 100% fee. · Suite 208 - 612 View St., downtown Victoria, between Broad and Government streets.
